import ast, json
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import torch
from arrival_budget import arrival_debit
from safeduo.safety.types import ARM_KEYS
source=Path('guard_native.py');tree=ast.parse(source.read_text())
cls=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name=='GuardTrace')
start=next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='start')
project=next(n for n in start.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='project')
branch=project.body[0].body[0]
fn=ast.parse('def adjust(self, env, rows, dt, kwargs):\n pass').body[0]
fn.body=[branch,ast.Return(ast.Name('kwargs',ast.Load()))]
space={};exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[fn],type_ignores=[])),str(source),'exec'),space)
q={a:torch.zeros(1,w,dtype=torch.float64) for a,w in zip(ARM_KEYS,(7,7,6,6))}
qd={a:v.clone() for a,v in q.items()};qd['U_R'][0,0]=-.3
state=SimpleNamespace(q=q,qd=qd,dt=1/60)
pending=[{a:v.clone() for a,v in q.items()} for _ in range(6)]
rows=SimpleNamespace(d=torch.tensor([[.085]],dtype=torch.float64),d_min=torch.tensor([[.02]],dtype=torch.float64),J={'F':torch.zeros(1,1,14,dtype=torch.float64),'U':torch.zeros(1,1,12,dtype=torch.float64)},valid=torch.ones(1,1,dtype=torch.bool),arm_mask=torch.tensor([[[False,False,False,True]]]))
rows.J['U'][0,0,6]=1
saved={k:v.clone() for k,v in vars(rows).items() if torch.is_tensor(v)}
savedJ={k:v.clone() for k,v in rows.J.items()}
savedstate={name:{a:v.clone() for a,v in getattr(state,name).items()} for name in ('q','qd')}
savedpending=[{a:v.clone() for a,v in target.items()} for target in pending]
env=SimpleNamespace(scene_state=lambda:state,_evaluation_actuator_delay=SimpleNamespace(queue=SimpleNamespace(pending=pending)))
kwargs=dict(dmin=rows.d_min,bypass_arm=torch.ones(1,4,dtype=torch.bool))
actual=space['adjust'](SimpleNamespace(mode='velocity_arrival'),env,rows,1/60,kwargs)
expected=rows.d_min+.1*(-torch.tensor([[-.3]],dtype=torch.float64)).clamp_min(0)
torch.testing.assert_close(actual['dmin'],expected,rtol=0,atol=0)
torch.testing.assert_close(actual['bypass_arm'],torch.tensor([[True,True,True,False]]),rtol=0,atol=0)
assert (rows.d-rows.d_min>.04).all() and (rows.d-actual['dmin']<=.04).all()
for k,v in saved.items():torch.testing.assert_close(getattr(rows,k),v,rtol=0,atol=0)
for k,v in savedJ.items():torch.testing.assert_close(rows.J[k],v,rtol=0,atol=0)
for name,values in savedstate.items():
 for a,v in values.items():torch.testing.assert_close(getattr(state,name)[a],v,rtol=0,atol=0)
for before,after in zip(savedpending,pending):
 for a,v in before.items():torch.testing.assert_close(after[a],v,rtol=0,atol=0)
assert kwargs['dmin'] is rows.d_min and kwargs['bypass_arm'].all()
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS_EXACT_60HZ_CPU_INTEGRATION',dt=1/60,pending_slots=6,horizon_s=.1,closing_m_s=.3,original_dmin=rows.d_min.tolist(),adjusted_dmin=actual['dmin'].tolist(),assertion_rtol=0,assertion_atol=0,original_raw_margin=(rows.d-rows.d_min).tolist(),new_budget_margin=(rows.d-actual['dmin']).tolist(),only_newly_threatened_UR_bypass_cleared=actual['bypass_arm'].tolist(),raw_rows_state_and_fifo_unchanged=True,extracts_original_guard_AST=True)))
